claims.claim: Salicylic acid is highly lipophilic, enabling it to dissolve sebum inside hair follicles and reduce non-inflammatory comedones.
Benzoyl peroxide acts as a powerful antimicrobial agent to kill Cutibacterium acnes, making it suitable for inflammatory cheek cysts.

sources.title: Clinical Efficacy of BHAs vs Benzoyl Peroxide in Acne Vulgaris
